mapper.select: SELECT f.revision,p.entries,p.all_confirmed FROM pf.file_entry f CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*)::integer AS entries,bool_and(child.collection_state='CONFIRMED') AS all_confirmed FROM (SELECT c.collection_state FROM pf.file_entry c WHERE c.space_id=f.space_id AND c.workspace_id=f.workspace_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND(c.relative_path=f.relative_path OR left(c.relative_path,length(f.relative_path)+1)=f.relative_path||'/') LIMIT 1001) child ) p WHERE f.id=#{file} AND f.space_id=#{space} AND f.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT f.id,f.workspace_id,f.relative_path AS path,f.kind,f.current_version_id AS version_id,f.revision,f.deletion_operation_id,f.deleted_at,f.retain_until, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_mutation_intent c JOIN pf.file_operation o ON o.id=c.operation_id AND o.status='COMMITTED' WHERE c.parent_operation_id=f.deletion_operation_id AND c.kind='DELETE_CLEANUP') AS can_restore FROM pf.file_entry f JOIN pf.file_mutation_intent m ON m.operation_id=f.deletion_operation_id AND m.root_file_id=f.id WHERE f.space_id=#{space} AND f.workspace_id=#{workspace} AND f.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND f.id<#{before} ORDER BY f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT f.id,f.space_id,f.workspace_id,f.relative_path,f.parent_path,f.name,f.kind,i.version_id AS current_version_id,f.collection_state,f.revision,i.sha256,i.size_bytes FROM pf.file_mutation_item i JOIN pf.file_entry f ON f.space_id=i.space_id AND f.workspace_id=i.workspace_id AND f.id=i.file_id WHERE i.operation_id=#{deletion} AND i.space_id=#{space} AND i.workspace_id=#{workspace} AND f.deletion_operation_id=#{deletion} AND f.deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.ordinal LIMIT 1001 FOR UPDATE OF f
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_entry WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL)

SELECT f.id,f.space_id,f.workspace_id,f.relative_path,f.parent_path,f.name,f.kind,f.current_version_id,f.collection_state,f.revision,v.sha256,v.size_bytes FROM pf.file_entry f LEFT JOIN pf.file_version v ON v.space_id=f.space_id AND v.id=f.current_version_id WHERE f.space_id=#{space} AND f.workspace_id=#{workspace} AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND(f.relative_path=#{path} OR left(f.relative_path,length(#{path})+1)=#{path}||'/') ORDER BY f.relative_path COLLATE "C" LIMIT 1001 FOR UPDATE OF f
SELECT file_id,source_path,target_path,kind,expected_revision,version_id,sha256,size_bytes FROM pf.file_mutation_item WHERE operation_id=#{operation} ORDER BY ordinal
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.file_entry SET relative_path=#{row.targetPath},parent_path=regexp_replace(#{row.targetPath},'(^|/)[^/]+$',''), name=regexp_replace(#{row.targetPath},'^.*/',''),revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{row.fileId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND relative_path=#{row.sourcePath} AND revision=#{row.expectedRevision} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_mutation_intent i WHERE i.operation_id=#{operation} AND i.space_id=file_entry.space_id AND i.workspace_id=file_entry.workspace_id)
